review:
Temple of Power is a Greek-god pay-anywhere slot from Perfect Position and BGaming, with Zeus watching every spin. It uses a transparent multiplier system.

Four buy options are available where permitted, including a Bonus round with multipliers from 2x to 1,000x and a Super Bonus with multipliers from 10x to 1,000x. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 15,000x maximum and a 96.03% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 372 spins. It's essentially BGaming's answer to Gates of Olympus.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 372 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
